rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a hatching blastocyst and acknowledges limited image quality, but it overstates confidence about a well-recognized blastocoel and cohesive TE/ICM features that are not clearly discernible in this single image.
Integrates age, AMH, BMI, PCOS, prior IVF/live birth, semen quality, and endometrium well, with appropriate emphasis on age-related aneuploidy risk and overall prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to morphology and age; minor overinterpretation of image details and speculative comments about PCOS response slightly weaken coherence.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading interpretation, single embryo transfer principles, luteal support, and selective consideration of PGT-A, though some lifestyle suggestions are more general than guideline-driven.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future cycles, including SET, protocol review, possible trigger adjustment, and uterine evaluation if failures recur; useful though not highly individualized beyond standard IVF management.
